rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１０Got a minute?￥Sorry, but I'm coming in.
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１１You've been on a roll lately...＝＠１０５＿０１２but if one good score has you￥all complacent, you've got￥another thing coming.
I know that.
What do you mean?
I know that.
What do you mean?
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１３Do you really get it? This place￥is full of experts gathered from￥all over the world, you know?
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１４Instead of getting carried away￥over one lucky break...＝＠１０５＿０１５you should think about keeping￥your scores where they are!
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１６Just what I said. If you space￥out, you'll get knocked down in￥no time!
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１７After all, this place is full of￥the world's top talent!
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０１８Well, even you probably wanted a￥good score at least once...＝＠１０５＿０１９so this'll make a nice keepsake,￥won't it?
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２０Just remember, luck like this￥doesn't keep coming around!
That was all me.
Who asked you, Riko?
That was all me.
Who asked you, Riko?
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２１Oh? Then keeping the same scores￥on future exams should be easy,￥right? I can't wait!!
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２２You obviously don't get it, so￥I'm going out of my way to tell￥you! You should be grateful!!

＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２３Honestly, I couldn't care less￥whether you get good scores￥or not.＝＠１０５＿０２４But if you think this was your￥real ability...＝＠１０５＿０２５then you're kidding yourself.￥I just came, out of kindness, to￥set you straight.
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２６Well, go ahead and bask in this￥score while you can. The next￥exam will wake you up!
＊Riko＊＠１０５＿０２７Well, see ya!!
